_meta.review_note: RW-CHECK: All Kinyarwanda pest names, symptoms, treatment and prevention text below should be reviewed by a native Kinyarwanda speaker / agronomist before production use. English is the reference translation.

rw: Kura udukoko ku mababi n'amaboko, ubite mu mazi y'isabune.
Baza umujyanama w'ubuhinzi ku muti wemewe wo kurwanya inyo.
Siba ibihingwa byanduye cyane kandi ubyite kure y'umurima.
en: Handpick caterpillars from leaves and drown them in soapy water.
Ask an agricultural extension worker about an approved pesticide for armyworm.
Remove and destroy heavily infested plants away from the field.

rw: Hinga ibigori n'ibishyimbo hamwe (push-pull) kugabanya inyo.
Sura umurima buri munsi ureba amagi n'uduhumbi.
Koresha imbuto zizewe kandi uhinge mu gihe gikwiye.
en: Intercrop maize with beans (push-pull) to reduce armyworm.
Scout the field every day for egg masses and caterpillars.
Use certified seed and plant at the right time.

rw: Kura ibihingwa byanduye ubyite kure y'umurima.
Baza umujyanama ku muti wemewe wo kurwanya umushyitsi.
Shyiramo umuti wemewe mu mwobo w'igiti uko wabwirwa n'umujyanama.
en: Remove and destroy infested plants away from the field.
Ask an extension worker about an approved stalk borer treatment.
Apply the approved product into the stem tunnel as advised.

rw: Hinga mu gihe gikwiye kandi ukoreshe imbuto zizewe.
Hindura ibihingwa mu murima buri mwaka.
en: Plant at the right time and use certified seed.
Rotate crops in the field every season.

pests.name_rw: Indwara ya Mosaic y'imyumbati (Cassava Mosaic Disease)

rw: Nta muti ugarukiriza mosaic; siba ibihingwa birwaye ubyite.
Koresha imbuto z'imyumbati zizewe (clean cuttings) gusa.
Baza umujyanama ku bijyanye no guhindura ubwoko bw'imyumbati.
en: There is no cure for mosaic; remove and destroy infected plants.
Use only certified disease-free cassava cuttings.
Ask an extension worker about switching to a resistant variety.

rw: Kura ibihingwa birwaye buri gihe ubibona.
en: Rogue out infected plants as soon as you see them.
Control whiteflies that spread the disease.

rw: Kura ibihingwa byanduye cyane ubyite kure y'umurima.
Baza umujyanama ku muti wemewe wo kurwanya isazi y'ibishyimbo.
Ongera ifumbire n'ubushyuhe bw'amazi kugira ngo ibishyimbo bikomeye.
en: Remove badly infested plants and destroy them away from the field.
Ask an extension worker about an approved bean fly treatment.
Improve soil fertility and watering so bean plants grow stronger.

rw: Hindura ibihingwa mu murima buri mwaka.
Koresha imbuto zizewe kandi uteye ku ntera ikwiye.
en: Plant beans at the right time.
Rotate crops in the field every season.
Use certified seed and correct spacing.

rw: Siba igitoke kirwaye ubyite kure y'umurima.
Sukura ibikoresho byose ukoresha mu murima buri gihe.
Baza umujyanama w'ubuhinzi vuba kugira ngo indwara itakwira.
en: Remove and destroy the infected banana plant away from the field.
Clean all tools used in the field after every use.
Contact an extension worker quickly to stop the disease spreading.

rw: Sukura ibikoresho mbere y'uko ukoresha mu murima undi.
Kura ibihingwa birwaye vuba uko bishoboka.
en: Clean tools before moving to another field.
Remove infected plants as early as possible.

rw: Kura amababi yanduye ubyite kure y'umurima.
Sasa umuti wemewe wo kurwanya late blight uko ibimera bikura.
Baza umujyanama ku muti wemewe n'igihe cyo kuwukoresha.
en: Remove infected leaves and destroy them away from the field.
Apply an approved late blight fungicide as the crop grows.
Ask an extension worker which product and timing to use.

rw: Tera ibirayi mu ntera ikwiye kugira ngo umwuka unyure.
Kura ibihingwa birwaye kandi utazongera kubyorora.
en: Plant with correct spacing so air can circulate.
Remove infected plants and do not compost them.
